submitted.rationale: Index 6 (In0.79Sb0.21, close to the In11Sb3O24 stoichiometry) had the highest measured EQE, 0.079%. Its XRD shows a rich In-rich pattern. It best matches In11Sb3O24 and InSbO4, but the similarity is weak (~0.35).

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.061%, lower than index 6. Sb-rich, near In3Sb5O12.
Measured EQE 0.031%. The more In-rich end is worse, so the merit peaks at intermediate In content.
